ConnectionStrings._comment: PostgreSQL (adr/0005-hosting-pivot-self-hosted-vps-postgresql.md — supersedes Azure SQL Database). This is a local-dev default only; the production connection string (a least-privilege role, never the database owner/superuser — governance/raid.md D-004) is supplied via an environment variable / systemd EnvironmentFile, never committed here.

App._comment: Local-dev placeholder. Production is https://www.varangians.co.uk, set by deploy/systemd/vlms-web.service (App__PublicBaseUrl). Used to build the absolute accept-invite link in guardian invite emails (Guardianship/GuardianInviteService.cs) — a relative link would not survive being copied into an email client.

Storage._comment: Local-disk certificate/lesson-asset storage (adr/0005-hosting-pivot-self-hosted-vps-postgresql.md — supersedes Azure Blob Storage). LocalRootPath is optional: Storage/LocalDiskBlobStorage.cs's own DefaultRootPath (App_Data/blobs, relative to the process working directory) is used when this key is absent or blank. Override for a real deployment path (e.g. /opt/vlms/blobs) once one is provisioned.

DataProtection._comment: Directory for the Data Protection key ring (auth cookies, guardian invite tokens) so it survives restarts. Required in Production (startup fails without it) — set by deploy/systemd/vlms-web.service to /var/lib/vlms/keys. Blank in Development uses the framework default (user profile). See Infrastructure/Security/VlmsDataProtection.cs.

Smtp._comment: PLACEHOLDER SMTP configuration (adr/0005-hosting-pivot-self-hosted-vps-postgresql.md — supersedes Azure Communication Services Email) — no live sending target exists yet, same status AzureAd/CommunicationServices had before a live target existed. Backs INotificationService (Vlms.Infrastructure/Notifications/), wired into Vlms.Web itself (not just Vlms.Jobs) so guardian invite emails (STATE.md 'Identity' item 5) can be sent from the web app. Sending target still undecided per the ADR (the org's existing Microsoft 365 mailbox vs. a free-tier transactional provider); no real secrets belong in this file (use an environment variable / systemd EnvironmentFile instead).
